title: Counting in My Class
text:
Numbers help us count things. In my class there are 24 students. The teacher has 30 books on her desk. We count them every morning.

The school bus has 45 seats. Many students sit next to each other. The bus driver is 55 years old. He drives every day, except on Sunday.

questions.text: How many students are in the class?
How many seats does the school bus have?
What can we infer about the bus driver?
options: He probably works most days of the week.
He is a student in the class.

questions.text: Why do the students probably count the books every morning?
options: To check that all the books are in the room.

vocabulary.definition: to say numbers in order to know how many things there are
people who are learning at a school

paragraph_translations: Os números nos ajudam a contar coisas. Na minha turma há 24 alunos. A professora tem 30 livros na mesa dela. Nós contamos todos eles toda manhã.
O ônibus escolar tem 45 assentos. Muitos alunos sentam um ao lado do outro. O motorista do ônibus tem 55 anos. Ele dirige todos os dias, exceto aos domingos.
